category_title: Struggling readers who view reading as a process of remembering and repeating
student_description: Alyssa is a struggling reader who relies on memorization, guessing, and watching the teacher rather than decoding print. She frequently attempts to share personal narratives to avoid phonics tasks and needs explicit redirection to the text along with specific phonetic scaffolding to build actual decoding skills.

criteria.rationale: Alyssa fundamentally misunderstands reading as a process of rote memorization, so she needs ongoing discussions about how and why decoding works.
criteria.check: The tutor's long-term plan must incorporate questions or reflections that ask the student to explain why they are learning phonics or how decoding helps them read new words.
